title: Behavioral refusal decision-patch (Gate B) - clearharm, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
plan: plan Appendix A / P0; phase docstring 'Gate B'
validator_type: refdecpatch (behavioral schema; checked by check_refdecpatch -> check_behavioral)
_what_this_is: Expected-arm manifest for the decision-patch behavioral run. expected_arms below reflects the SCRIPT DEFAULTS (--band 15,16,17 --head-layer 17); check_manifest detects these via behav_arms() and reports any arm MISSING (never launched) vs present.
_notes: Run-dir naming: refdecpatch_<cohort>_<ts>_<uniq>; resolved by the shorter-prefix rule.

Arms are parameterized by --band (necessity: ds_dpatch_direct_L{band}) and --head-layer (rand/self controls at L{HL}). Values here are the script defaults band=[15,16,17], HL=17, component resid_post. Re-issue this manifest if a run overrides --band/--head-layer.
check_refdecpatch additionally requires ds_base + direct_base and at least one ds_dpatch_direct_L* necessity arm; those are covered by expected_arms.
expected_splits = script default --splits train,dev,test; bench data/behavioral_v3/beh_clearharm.json carries train/dev/test = 85/43/42.

arm_roles.ds_dpatch_direct_L*: NECESSITY: resid_post <- Direct donor; does refusal return?
arm_roles.ds_dpatch_self_L17: LOCALITY no-op: DS own value, must ~= ds_base
